decision_rule.continuous_value: independently replicated cells: robust -> also replicated at a fourth site, not robust -> flagged (no automatic demotion); candidate or not-promoted cells move up one level when robust (v12 rule)
decision_rule.own_trajectory_point: robust -> the cell's own-trajectory residual becomes an external candidate (one site); replacing the expert needs a second unused database; else the cell keeps the expert
decision_rule.single_event_probability: robust (O/E in [0.8, 1.25] in >= 4/5 samples, >= 30 events, threshold strictly inside the observed range) -> external candidate; else the event probability is not output
decision_rule.joint_dependence: robust (energy and variogram both better in >= 4/5 samples) -> the block becomes an external candidate; else the block outputs independent marginals; a block is evaluable in a sample only if its vectors cover every target and every horizon and number >= 100 from >= 30 patients, so a few supported cells never stand for the whole block
decision_rule.not_evaluable: a cell without support (urine_output and glucose_poc at INSPIRE) keeps its status with the reason recorded; every part reports planned and evaluable denominators
decision_rule.registry: any registry change requires the user's approval
